description.value: Concept properties for HL7 organizational entities.

definition.value: A string property for the type of an HL7 organisational entity. Values are 'Work Group', 'Management Group', 'Council', 'Governance Group', 'Affiliate', 'Affiliate Work Group', 'Affiliate Governance Group', 'Product Director', 'Executive'.
A string property for the status of an organizational entity. Values are 'active' and 'inactive'.
A code property for the HL7 Affiliate an organization entity may be associated with.
